profiles.name: Diabolus
speciesTraits: Medium Outsider with the Native and Chaotic subtypes. Land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and no racial ability score adjustments. The playable profile adds no racial Hit Dice. LA +1.
Gain +2 racial on saving throws against spells and spell-like effects. The Chaotic subtype counts for alignment-dependent effects, and attacks overcome damage reduction as chaotic-aligned.
Gain +2 racial on Intimidate against animals and humanoids. Take −2 on Diplomacy, Handle Animal, Perform, and Sense Motive.
Weapon Familiarity treats the trident as a simple weapon.

The tail is a secondary natural attack at −5, with 1d4 base damage. Its injury poison takes a Fortitude save at DC 10 + half total HD, rounded down, + Constitution modifier. The initial effect is sickened for 2d4 rounds. There is no secondary damage. The Compendium gives 3 + Constitution modifier doses per day.
A sickened creature takes −2 on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks.

Automatic languages are Diabolan and Diaboli tail code. Bonus languages are Abyssal, Common, Draconic, and Infernal. The visual code takes about twice as long as speech. A viewer can recognize the use of a code with a DC 10 Intelligence check. Anyone can learn it, and only a tailed speaker can produce it.
Favored class Sorcerer. Bare, common, and hirsute Diaboli share the same rules.

npcBuilds.name: Zareth Flintmere

build.title: Diabolus dry causeway keeper, Fighter 1
build.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
traits: Chaotic good. Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +4, Reflex +2, Will +1. Against spells and spell-like effects: Fortitude +6, Reflex +4, Will +3. Armor check penalty −1.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Focus (trident) adds +1 to melee and thrown trident attacks. Diaboli treat a trident as simple.
Tail poison has five doses per day from Constitution 14 and is delivered by a successful tail hit. Use the initial save only. The Fortitude save DC is 12.
actions: Trident +4 melee or +4 thrown, 1d8+2 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. melee reach or 10-ft. range increment.
Tail −2 melee, 1d4+1 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Full attack with trident +4 and tail −2. The tail attack uses the secondary penalty.
On a tail hit with a dose available, spend it and apply Fortitude DC 12. Failure sickens for 2d4 rounds. The tail still deals its normal damage if there is no dose left.
build.tactics: Zareth wants to get a loaded handcart across the causeway before the water rises. He can warn another tail-code speaker about a loose stone. If something attacks the cart, he uses his trident from the narrow approach and adds the tail if he can stand and make a full attack.

npcBuilds.motive: Get the cart across before the water covers the loose paving.
npcBuilds.hook: Zareth waves the party toward the cart while he checks the narrow end of the causeway. Vessa can translate if needed.

npcBuilds.name: Vessa Nettle

build.title: Diabolus echo stair interpreter, Sorcerer 1
build.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
traits: Chaotic good. Unarmored, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 10. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +1, Reflex +2, Will +2. Against spells and spell-like effects: Fortitude +3, Reflex +4, Will +4.

Spell Focus (Enchantment) adds +1 to enchantment save DCs. Sorcerer caster level 1. Spontaneous casting, five 0-level slots and four 1st-level slots per day. Carries a spell component pouch and has no familiar.
Tail poison has four doses per day from Constitution 12. Fortitude DC 11 against the initial sickened effect. Vessa can translate tail code into Common.
actions: Trident +0 melee or +2 thrown, 1d8 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. melee reach or 10-ft. range increment. Weapon Familiarity makes the trident simple.

Tail −5 melee, 1d4 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Full attack with trident +0 and tail −5. A tail hit with a dose spends it and causes 2d4 rounds of sickness unless the target makes Fortitude DC 11.

Charm person (1st): standard action, one Humanoid within 25 ft., Will DC 15 negates, duration 1 hour. Spell resistance applies. A target threatened or attacked by Vessa or her allies gets +5 on the save.
Shield (1st): standard action, personal, 1 minute. AC becomes 16 and flat-footed AC 14. Ordinary touch AC remains 12. Stops magic missile and protects against incorporeal touch.
Cantrips known: daze (one Humanoid up to 4 HD within 25 ft., Will DC 14 negates, spell resistance applies, one round), detect magic, light, and mage hand.
build.tactics: Vessa is relaying silent warnings along a stair where voices carry. She translates for surface travellers. She casts shield if someone corners her, and would rather persuade a frightened humanoid to let her pass than stay to fight.

npcBuilds.motive: Relay warnings without speaking in the passage.
npcBuilds.hook: Vessa can interpret a warning from the keeper across the landing and show the party which stair is open.
